data_description.power_entity: Power sensor (W) for the appliance's plug. Prefer the unfiltered sensor: smoothing filters hold their last value after the appliance switches off.
data_description.programs: Program names to label cycles with, e.g. Cottons, Eco. You can add more later.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already monitored.

data_description.start_power: A cycle starts when power stays at or above this for the start delay.
data_description.end_power: A cycle ends when power stays below this for the end delay. Make the delay longer than any pause mid-cycle.
data_description.stale_timeout: If the sensor sends nothing for this long, treat power as 0 W from its last update. 0 disables.
data_description.finished_timeout: How long the state stays finished before returning to idle. 0 keeps it until the next cycle.
